elements.requirement: A control order ceases to have effect at the expiry of five years beginning with the date on which the order came into force.
elements.quote: ceases to have effect at the expiry of the period of five years beginning with the date on which it came into force

elements.requirement: The local housing authority may revoke a control order by order at any earlier time, either on an application or on their own initiative.
elements.quote: may at any earlier time, either on application or on their own initiative, by order revoke a control order

elements.requirement: The local housing authority must serve notice of their intention to revoke a control order on the persons occupying any part of the house at least 21 days before revoking it.
elements.quote: serve notice of their intention to do so on— (a) the persons occupying any part of the house

elements.requirement: The local housing authority must serve notice of their intention to revoke a control order at least 21 days before revocation on every person who is known to the authority to be an owner, lessee or mortgagee of the house.
elements.quote: every person who is to the knowledge of the authority an owner, lessee or mortgagee of the house

elements.requirement: If a person applies to the local authority requesting revocation of a control order and provides grounds for the request, the authority must inform the applicant of their decision and their reasons for rejecting the grounds if they refuse the application.
elements.quote: inform the applicant of their decision and of their reasons for rejecting the grounds advanced by him

elements.requirement: Where the local housing authority propose to revoke a control order on their own initiative and apply to the county court, the court may approve the serving of a notice requiring execution of works under section 352 or 372, the giving of a direction limiting occupants under section 354, or the making of an order applying a management code under section 370, to take effect upon the revocation of the control order.
elements.quote: the court may approve the taking of any of the following steps to take effect on the revocation of the control order

elements.requirement: No appeal lies against a notice or order approved by the county court under subsection (5) to take effect upon the revocation of a control order.
elements.quote: no appeal lies against a notice or order so approved

thresholds.what: period after which a control order ceases to have effect
thresholds.quote: period of five years beginning with the date on which it came into force

thresholds.what: minimum advance notice required before the local housing authority revokes a control order
thresholds.quote: at least 21 days before revoking a control order
